description: Twenty years ago, you met Luke Danes...backward cap, plaid flannel, pouring the coffee. For the VERY first time, Scott Patterson (aka Luke) is watching Gilmore Girls. 154 episodes and 4 movies. We'll visit Stars Hollow, Doosey's Market, Miss Patty's, Mrs. Kim's antique shop and more pop culture references than you can count. Join us whether you're Team Dean, Team Logan or Team Jess. And, we'll see if we can figure out "who's the daddy". We'll talk fast, and if you can smell snow, if Paris isn't just a city in France, and Friday night dinner is a requirement... you don't want to miss this. Finally, cell phones are allowed. Listen everywhere you listen to podcasts. I AM ALL IN, an iHeartRadio podcast.

episodes.title: Gilmore Girls Gazette: Parenthood:  We Were Warned It’s A lot (Season 4 E7 & E8)
episodes.description:
Things are getting super emotional as Kristina’s cancer journey unfolds. What moment has us reaching for the tissues?

 

Meanwhile, one Braverman is making some major parenting missteps. Find out why we're firmly Team Mark in this episode.

 

Plus, we love the fashion choice from Amber, but is it realistic that she would down a couture dress?

episodes.title: Stars Hollow Style: Work It Lorelai! (S2 E19 “Back in the Saddle Again”)
episodes.description:
Get ready for some ALL TIME great Lorelai work outfits in this episode! We get a glimpse of the fashion icon Giselle and a three-way showdown of looks in downtown Stars Hollow from Rory, Lane and Dean. 

Plus, a favorite Rory dress from season 1 makes a return!

episodes.title: Gilmore Girls Gazette: Breaking Milo Ventimiglia Baby News
episodes.description:
Milo Ventimiglia and his wife Jarah have welcomed their new baby! Find out the unique name they gave their new bundle of joy. 

 

Are we seeing deja vu when it comes to Melissa McCarthy’s new series about Jon Benet Ramsey? Where will you be able to watch the much anticipated show?

 

Plus, did anyone from  Gilmore Girls  make the guest list for Taylor Swift's wedding? We went through the names and have the answer.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: IAAI Town Meeting: The Jess of It All  (Season 4 E12 “A Family Matter”)
episodes.description:
We’re officially halfway through Season 4, and things are picking up fast… and we all know what’s coming.

 

Jason is doing the MOST with his behavior in Stars Hollow. Between the painfully drawn out banter and those constant international calls he is giving us major ICK.

 

We finally meet Liz Danes, and Jess casually pops back into town… are we the only ones noticing a few plot holes along the way?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: I Am All In…Again: A Real Housewife Meets Stars Hollow (Season 4 E12 “A Family Matter”
episodes.description:
From the Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, Amanda Frances joins Scott to recap Season 4 E12 “A Family Matter”

 

Amanda’s been a super fan for 20 years! Which iconic scene in Gilmore Girls reminds her of her experience on RHOBH? 

 

Plus, Bravo fans want to know, will Amanda return for another season?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: IAAI Town Meeting: I Smell Fake Snow (Season 4 E11 “In the Clamor and the Clangor”)
episodes.description:
Stars Hollow may be covered in snow, but we’re convinced it looks a lot more like white sand than a winter wonderland. 

 

Doose’s Market is not messing around with their specials, we caught one sale sign that made us LOL. 

 

Plus, Suzanne shares a realization she’s  never had before, all thanks to a brief line about Lane and Dave that completely flew over our heads. 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: I Am All In…Again: I’d Like You to Chase Me Now (Season 4 E11 “In the Clamor and the Clangor”)
episodes.description:
Town Meeting host Tara Soudbaksh joins Scott to recap Season 4 E11 “In the Clamor and the Clangor”

 

Scott breaks down why we’re Team Luke in this episode and why Lorelai may be crossing a line. 

 

Plus, the emotional moments between Mrs Kim and Lane got us tearing up, but did it all happen too quickly and suddenly?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Luke’s Diner: A Simple Way to Make a Luke’s Diner Pancake
episodes.description:
On this week’s Luke’s Diner, Emmy Award-winning chef Frankie Celenza from Tastemade pulls up a chair. 

 

The very surprising way Frankie used a special method to cook for the number one tennis player Novak Djokovic. 

 

Find out how to not waste a dime on food with Frankie’s  Tastemade show “Struggle Meals.” 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Gilmore Girls Gazette: Parenthood: I See Your Haddie and Raise You Amber  (Season 4 E5 & E6)
episodes.description:
Are we seeing the beginning of the end for two staple Braverman couples? Including one relationship many of us never imagined would hit trouble waters…

 

A big shout out to Sarah Ramos and Meg Whitman’s performances in this episode! These two have completely made us emotional. 

 

Plus, a burning hot take about Ray Romano, we’d love to hear from you!
